notes: Sequential mode0/rate/window/both/mode0 sweeps. Each four-point sweep requests 1G, 4G, 21G and unlimited in each direction for twenty seconds per point.

Rate override is 4,000,000,000 outer bytes/s; window override is 8MiB except during ProbeRTT drain. BBR quantum/max_datagram, accounting, grants, PTO and retained storage capacities remain unchanged. Stalled PTO still sets a zero ordinary window.
These are causal diagnostics, not production candidates. The isolated baseline predates later PMTU sent-history and liveness fixes.
Mode0 has the same controller behavior as baseline but a different binary hash; fresh mode0 measurements bracket variants.
No local compilation, local kernel tests, live snapshots or Git packing overlapped measurement.
Goodput excludes drain, missing fractions and counter deltas include drain. CPU100% means one core; differing drop counter units cannot be summed into exact frame loss.
End-of-run snapshots do not prove that a limit was never reached during a run. ProbeRTT and stalled PTO remain potential constraints in override variants.
All records remain valid and duplicate-free; no inner UDP errors or outer fragments. Window and combined overrides introduce outer socket overflow, reported per point.
